name: Triumph Rocket III / Rocket 3
engine: 2294 or 2458 cc liquid-cooled inline triple, fuel injected, shaft drive
intro: The biggest production motorcycle engine. Shaft drive, huge torque and several brake recalls on the new Rocket 3.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2005 bikes are in recall 05V004 (final drive unit). 2006 bikes are in recall 06V063 (handlebar clamp bolts). 2020-2021 Rocket 3s are in recall 20V740 (air in the ABS modulator). 2020-2024 Rocket 3s are in recall 23V730 (rear brake master cylinder).
A-002.reason: Brake and final drive faults are crash risks. Every fix is free.

recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the final drive unit free.

recalls.what: Handlebar clamp bolts may not be tight.
recalls.fix: Dealer checks and tightens the clamp bolts free.

recalls.what: Air in the ABS modulator can reduce rear braking.
recalls.fix: Dealer flushes and replaces the rear brake fluid free.

recalls.what: Rear brake master cylinder problem can lengthen stopping distance.
